# Air Pollution Prediction Commons

## About

The goal of the appc package is to provide daily, high resolution, near
real-time, model-based ambient air pollution exposure assessments. This
is achieved by training a generalized random forest on several
geomarkers to predict daily average EPA AQS concentrations from 2017
until the near-present (currently June 2026) at exact locations across
the contiguous United States (see the [model-performance
report](https://geomarker.io/appc/articles/cv-model-performance.html)
for more details).

APPC collects and harmonizes EPA AQS outcomes and handles model
development, evaluation, and prediction. The [geomarker
package](https://geomarker.io/geomarker/) supplies the environmental
predictors.

## Installing

Install the latest stable release of appc from R-universe with:

``` r

install.packages("appc", repos = c("https://geomarker-io.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

Install the latest, under-development version of appc from GitHub with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("geomarker-io/appc")
```

## Example

In R, create model-based predictions of ambient air pollution
concentrations at exact locations on specific dates using the
[`predict_pm25()`](https://geomarker.io/appc/reference/predict_pm25.md)
function:

``` r

appc::predict_pm25(
  x = s2::as_s2_cell(c("8841b39a7c46e25f", "8841a45555555555")),
  dates = list(as.Date(c("2025-05-18", "2025-06-10")), as.Date(c("2025-06-22", "2025-09-20")))
)
```

See more examples in the [timeline
example](https://geomarker.io/appc/articles/timeline-example.html).

You can also pass a geomarker `s2cd` object directly. Its stored dates
are used:

``` r

locations <- geomarker::s2cd(
  s2::as_s2_cell(c("8841b39a7c46e25f", "8841a45555555555")),
  dates = list(as.Date(c("2025-05-18", "2025-06-10")), as.Date("2025-06-22"))
)
appc::predict_pm25(locations, keep_predictors = TRUE)
```

## Environmental predictors

APPC uses the [geomarker package](https://geomarker.io/geomarker/) for
environmental predictor assessment. See its documentation for S2
location/date inputs, available geomarkers, and source-data management.

## Data storage

Environmental downloads and assessment are managed by geomarker under
its own R user data directory. See [geomarker’s data and
offline-operation documentation](https://geomarker.io/geomarker/) for
cache and source-refresh options. APPC retains AQS outcomes, assembled
training data, and fitted models under
`tools::R_user_dir("appc", "data")`. Set `R_USER_DATA_DIR` to choose a
different root for both packages.

## Developing

The committed workflow has two steps:

``` sh
just make_training_data
just train_model
```

The first script downloads and harmonizes AQS outcomes, assembles
predictors with geomarker, and saves the training data. The second reads
that table and fits the model. These are large, manually invoked jobs.
Neither is run by package checks.

Use terra 1.9.46 or newer to avoid the [compressed NetCDF extraction
slowdown](https://github.com/rspatial/terra/issues/2145) in earlier 1.9
versions. The training-data script normally refreshes current-year AQS
outcomes. After a successful AQS refresh, you can reuse that annual
cache when restarting predictor assembly:

``` r

options(appc.refresh_aqs = FALSE)
source("inst/make_training_data.R")
```

Install the package dependencies from the repository root:

``` r

pak::pak(".")
```

The model specification in `inst/` records the predictors, date
coverage, and exact geomarker dependency used for training. Retain the
assembled training artifact to reproduce fitting after upstream AQS or
weather revisions. Use a dedicated `R_USER_DATA_DIR` for an official
build so existing local monthly MERRA overrides are not picked up
unintentionally. No automatic NASA source refresh is performed.

Move existing artifacts aside before rebuilding.

Run `just render_model_dash` to evaluate the model. Set
`APPC_BUILD_MODEL_ARTICLES=true` when rebuilding model-dependent pkgdown
articles. Ordinary package checks skip these large jobs.

# Package index

## Air pollution assessment

- [`predict_pm25()`](https://geomarker.io/appc/reference/predict_pm25.md)
  : Get daily PM2.5 model predictions
- [`predict_pm25_date_range()`](https://geomarker.io/appc/reference/predict_pm25_date_range.md)
  : Get daily PM2.5 model predictions using date ranges
- [`assemble_predictors()`](https://geomarker.io/appc/reference/assemble_predictors.md)
  : Assemble predictors for the PM2.5 model

## Helpers

- [`latlon_to_s2_cell()`](https://geomarker.io/appc/reference/latlon_to_s2_cell.md)
  : Convert latitude/longitude vectors into S2 cells

- [`get_daily_aqs()`](https://geomarker.io/appc/reference/get_daily_aqs.md)
  : Get daily AQS concentrations

- [`install_aqs()`](https://geomarker.io/appc/reference/install_aqs.md)
  : Install daily PM2.5 averages

- [`appc_clean_data_directory()`](https://geomarker.io/appc/reference/appc_clean_data_directory.md)
  :

  delete all installed data files in the user's data directory for the
  `appc` package
